scenario.name: Slovene with Slavko
scenario.title: Slovene with Slavko
scenario.character: Slavko, a warm, curious dragon who is the learner's companion through the course — he speaks Slovene to them from the first second and is unmistakably on their side
scenario.setup: A brand-new learner's first contact with the language. Slavko meets them, tells them who he is, and wants to know who they are — the name exchange is the one thing he can genuinely want from someone who owns no words at all.

levels.title: Meeting Slavko
frameEN: This is Slavko. He's a dragon, and he's going to teach you Slovene.
He speaks only Slovene — you'll follow more than you expect, because he repeats everything: in a sentence, then on its own, then slowly.
He talks, then it's your turn. Say it out loud — you can't get it wrong here.
He's going to want your name.

objectives.label: Introduce yourself
objectives.descriptorEN: Say 'Sem ___.' out loud with your own name in the slot.

objectives.label: Say it again when asked
objectives.descriptorEN: Give the same line back when Slavko asks to hear it once more.

objectives.label: Name yourself on the way out

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Oj, živjo! Sem Slavko. Sem Slavko.
n1.en: Oh, hi! I'm Slavko. I'm Slavko.
